lines.text: Joshua orders large stones rolled against the mouth of the cave at Makkedah where the five kings hid.
Joshua has the five kings brought out of the cave and tells his commanders to put their feet on their necks.
Joshua kills the five kings, hangs them on five trees until morning, then has them thrown into the cave.
Joshua moves from Makkedah to Libnah, Lachish, Eglon, Hebron and Debir, capturing each city and leaving no survivors.
Joshua conquers the land from Kadesh-barnea to Gaza in one campaign because the LORD fought for Israel, then returns to Shiloh.
